baseFrontend: Rebuilt from official Admin 8.3.5 sources plus reviewed EOS integration using React 19 and Vite; see source-bound frontend manifest.
notes: Preserves the existing ioBroker Admin and the combined EOS login/runtime.
One central NWL3 activation, private persistence and authorized public-key recovery.
Manufacturer vault/private keys stay on the issuer computer; live-device acceptance remains required.

Persist an EOS-only Socket.IO secret under private instance data; keep system.config native secret unchanged
Stop automatic updates of foreign adapter, global system, enum, user and existing group ACLs or metadata
Keep existing Administrator group intact when EOS role lists are empty; create only absent dedicated EOS groups
Preserve standard Backitup instances and archives outside NexoWatt legacy migration
Retain the 9.0.16 device-saving, settings-preservation, idle-timeout and verified repository-publishing fixes
Do not rewrite global repository ordering or controller/foreign-adapter automatic upgrade policies; retain historic recovery records and block only EOS-initiated unattended installation
status: 9.0.17 integration test release; release evidence and target-device acceptance remain separate
